name: U.S. Department of the Treasury — daily interest rate XML feed
access: HTTPS GET to home.treasury.gov (Atom/XML); no API key described
cost_model: Free (no fee or key stated on the feed documentation page)

rate_limit.source: No published rate limit found (CAP-DATA-06). Self-imposed polite pacing: one request every 2 s; ingestion fetches one month or one year per request.

failure_behavior: Connection errors, 429 or 5xx: bounded exponential backoff, then the run fails and is reported; stored curves keep their availability times. A date with no curve (holiday, not yet published) is never filled or interpolated; readers fall back to the previous curve date with a label.

datasets.description: Daily Treasury par yield curve rates (nominal), tenors 1M, 1.5M, 2M, 3M, 4M, 6M, 1Y, 2Y, 3Y, 5Y, 7Y, 10Y, 20Y, 30Y, percent as published
datasets.coverage: US Treasury nominal par curve (indicative bid-side quotations at or near 3:30 PM; monotone convex method since 2021-12-06)
datasets.update_frequency: Each trading day; 'usually available ... by 6:00 PM Eastern Time' (Treasury methodology page, CAP-MAC-07)
datasets.availability_rule: Live capture (fetched on or before 23:59:59 America/New_York of the curve date): available at first-seen receipt time. Backfill (fetched later): available at 23:59:59 America/New_York on the curve date, flagged availability_estimated_backfill. A changed value on re-fetch is a new publication available at its own receipt time, flagged revised_after_first_seen.
datasets.rights_source: Feed documentation page states no licence text (CAP-DATA-06: 'US government source; verify'); Fiscal Data API states data is free without restriction for commercial or non-commercial use. Cloud-model processing and redistribution withheld until the feed's site policies are reviewed.
datasets.rights_status: provisional — feed-specific terms not yet reviewed (open question in CAP-DATA-06)
